cards.definition_principle: A trade plan should identify the exact structural observation that disproves the thesis before mapping that boundary to an option premium stop.
measurable_predicates: completed close or precise failure predicate is fixed
premium stop mapping status is disclosed
valid_conditions: The stop cannot be loosened beyond the authorized maximum loss.
failure_conditions: Stop is arbitrary, fixed by desired R multiple, or moved after adverse price action.
contradictions: A literature principle cannot choose the numeric stop; current deterministic analysis must do so.
when_not_to_use: Do not use a support/resistance card as execution authorization.
cards.paraphrase: Use predeclared market structure to define thesis failure, then map it transparently to premium risk.

cards.definition_principle: A natural target is a pre-existing verified structure or liquidity location; it is not stretched to manufacture a desired reward-risk ratio.
measurable_predicates: target source ID and freshness are recorded
valid_conditions: At least one reachable target survives fresh revalidation.
failure_conditions: Target disappears, becomes stale, or is created from a fixed multiple.
contradictions: A historical level can fail and does not guarantee a premium target.
when_not_to_use: Do not use unvalidated FVG/order-block targets in production.
cards.paraphrase: Reference immutable current-market locations and disclose uncertainty; never back-solve a target from desired RR.

cards.definition_principle: Reward-risk is an output of executable entry, structural stop, natural targets, costs, and slippage; it cannot manufacture those inputs.
measurable_predicates: entry uses current ask or price band
valid_conditions: RR is recomputed after every material input change.
failure_conditions: Stop or target is selected to force 1R/2R.
contradictions: A good-looking RR does not validate the thesis or fill quality.
when_not_to_use: Do not cite literature to override the deterministic planner or Risk Authorization.
cards.exact_locator: Regulation 4.41 proposed disclaimer > hypothetical performance limitations
cards.paraphrase: Include execution and liquidity realities; never optimize a plan presentation with hindsight.
